propositions: The gate matches field names globally as bare attribute terminals, so any field whose name is read on any unrelated object anywhere under src/rebar passes the gate regardless of whether that field itself is read.
The gate cannot police common reused field names (enabled, path, timeout, remote, branch, mode) because those names are likely read on multiple configs, causing false negatives.

The gate must be fixed to resolve reads to their owning dataclass rather than matching as bare attribute names, then the fixed gate must be run across the whole schema and newly-flagged fields must be reported without triaging them.

Four fields are newly flagged when the gate is fixed with proper owner resolution: McpConfig.readonly, McpConfig.allow_llm, McpConfig.allow_jira_sync, and JiraConfig.allow_insecure, all of which are genuinely live and read through documented indirection.
Each newly-flagged field must receive a factual read-via marker citing its real reader, and no field must be silently exempted to make CI green.
The fix must preserve existing negative fixtures (ReconcilerConfig.lock_lease_secs and VerifyConfig require_plan_review fields) and report any read-via marker that names a closed ticket id.
